        <li>Measuring how close TCP gets to RoCE for LLM serving and fine-tuning on Ethernet GPU clusters, showing that it stays within 4% of RoCE in pipeline-parallel serving.</li>
        <li>Distilling small language models to assess their improvement potential for autonomous network management, nearly tripling their success rate on operational networking tasks.</li>
        <li>Built RouteMind, an LLM agent framework that generates BGP configurations and negotiates routing policy between autonomous systems in emulated networks.</li>
        <li>Designed NetLLMBench, an open benchmark that checks LLM-generated network configurations in emulation.</li>
        <li>Analyzed on a hardware testbed how TCP and QUIC behave when data center networks are reconfigured at runtime, and predicted the resulting slowdowns with an ML model that explains 88% of their variance.</li>
